main.description: Looks up one indexed funding receipt by exact AT-URI and hydrates its publisher actor. The full receipt record is preserved unchanged, including amount as a decimal string; parties and funded targets remain unexpanded. A receipt is not proof that payment occurred. Missing author profile or organization sidecar is null; operational hydration failures return errors. A missing indexed receipt is RecordNotFound. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full funding-receipt record AT-URI using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not a funding-receipt record AT-URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed funding receipt exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: ReceiptQueryFailed
errors.description: The receipt query or publisher hydration lookup failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

receiptView.description: Funding-receipt record view with hydrated publisher actor and the full indexed record unchanged; party and funded-target references remain unexpanded. A receipt is not proof that payment occurred.
